Searches were conducted by boat and by air but the bodies of Paul Scott and Richard Petawanahqueb were never recovered.  Paul and Richard are presumed dead due to drowning. Mario Marabella, 40 years old, was on his way to a meeting when he was abducted on December 4, 2008 in Laval, Quebec.  Mario was at a Petro-Canada service station on Highway 440 between highways 19 and 25 around 4:00 p.m. when three people forced him into a van and fled.

A few hours later the car was found burning at the corner of Gouin Boulevard and Lambert St. in Montréal, Quebec.
